podcast.title: Fourth Wave Punk End
podcast.body: This group from New Brunswick, New Jersey, leans towards the punk side of the fourth wave of Ska. They are cited as an example of a new generation of Ska bands emerging between 2002 and 2004. "Well, there's a group from New Brunswick, New Jersey called Street Light Manifesto, the lean on the punk end of things."
